sn22.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn22.5:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca
sn22.5:1.7: rūpassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca saññāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca saṅkhārānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca viññāṇassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca.
sn22.5:2.1: ko ca bhikkhave rūpassa samudayo ko vedanāya samudayo ko saññāya samudayo ko saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo ko viññāṇassa samudayo.
sn22.5:2.2: idha bhikkhave abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn22.5:3.3: tassa rūpaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
sn22.5:4.5: tassa viññāṇaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi
sn22.5:6.1: ko ca bhikkhave rūpassa atthaṅgamo ko vedanāya.
sn22.5:7.1: idha bhikkhave nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn22.5:8.3: tassa rūpaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā rūpe nandi sā nirujjhati
sn22.5:9.2: tassa vedanaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā vedanāya nandi sā nirujjhati
sn22.5:10.3: tassa saṅkhāre anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā saṅkhāresu nandi sā nirujjhati
sn22.5:11.2: tassa viññāṇaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā viññāṇe nandi sā nirujjhati
sn22.5:12.1: ayaṃ bhikkhave rūpassa atthaṅgamo ayaṃ vedanāya atthaṅgamo ayaṃ saññāya atthaṅgamo ayaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo ayaṃ viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
